title: Content Project
description: The shape of a content_projects row as returned by any workflow that creates or reads one — introduced by create_manual_topic_project() (Step 5) but intended to be reused as-is by every later stage (research, scripting, rendering, publishing) rather than redefined per-workflow. See docs/architecture/database-architecture.md#content-lifecycle and docs/architecture/topic-intake.md#topic-lifecycle.

storage_path.description: channels/{channel_id}/projects/{content_project_id}/, derived from the channel's canonical storage_namespace.

already_existed.description: true when this response is an idempotent replay of a previously created project (content_projects.(channel_id, idempotency_key) matched), not a fresh row.

topic_candidate_id.description: Present only on a fresh creation, not an idempotent replay.
